def max_power_sums(n, core_connections):

def calculate_time(n, g, r, l, q, times):
    # Total time to cross the entire path without considering lights
    total_time = sum(l)
    
    # Initialize the time to the last intersection as the time it leaves the source
    last_time = times[-1]

    # Calculate the number of intersections a bus will stop at based on its arrival time
    stops = (last_time - 1) // g

    # Calculate the total time that includes the rest of the trip after the last stop
    remaining_time = (last_time - 1) % g

    # Calculate the previous rest time, before this bus would possibly enter the rest period
    prev_rest_time = (total_time - (stops - 1) * l[-1]) % (g + r)

    # Calculate time left over at the current red light beyond the rest period before next green light
    time_after_next_green = min(remaining_time, prev_rest_time - g + r)

    # The final time the bus reaches the destination
    time_destination = last_time + (total_time - l[-1]) + time_after_next_green

    return time_destination

    # returns the maximum potential of any BubbleCore.

    active_cores = connections.copy()
    
    def update_potential(results):
        # Update the result with the maximum potential of any BubbleCore
        max_pot = max(results)
        if max_pot > results[0]:
            return max_pot
            
        return results[0]

    for i, j in connections:
        potentials[i] += 1
        potentials[j] += 1
